<!-- gitissue:normalized v1 -->

## Type

feature (high confidence)

## Description

Issue #102 added the `system1` benchmark suite — 23 decision scenarios / 49 typed
questions measuring accuracy and speed through an OpenAI-compatible endpoint —
and named two System One model candidates:

- `bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B`
- `convaiinnovations/laya`

The suite was implemented and validated but never executed against either
candidate, so no benchmark numbers exist for them yet. This issue covers
serving both models and running the suite end-to-end so the candidates can be
compared against each other and the incumbent baseline on this machine.

Incumbent baseline, measured on this machine 2026-09-30
(`unsloth/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-NVFP4` served as `montimage-dgx-spark` on vLLM,
benchkit `system1`, samples=2, n=98):

- think OFF: **96.9 %** accuracy (95 % CI 91.4–99.0) · 0.7 s/task · 4 out-tokens/task
- think ON: **93.9 %** accuracy (95 % CI 87.3–97.2) · 22.6 s/task · 1,149 out-tokens/task · 4 truncated at 16k

Raw results: `results/2026-09-30/incumbent-qwen3-6-s1-{off,on}.json`

Serving constraints found while building the suite:

- **Bespoke-Nimble-9B** — its reference workflow scores answer-token logits
  over the allowed choices rather than generating freely; it needs a merged
  checkpoint an OpenAI-compatible server (e.g. vLLM) can serve as an ordinary
  chat model.
- **Laya** — a non-autoregressive decision model with a typed
  `predict(state, questions)` API; it exposes no OpenAI-compatible surface, so
  it needs a shim endpoint translating the suite's chat calls to `predict`.

**Related components:**
`system1` suite (`./bench run --suite system1`), `configs/` serving recipes, `results/` archive

**Related issues:**
#102 (added the suite; closed by PR #103)

> **Reporter Context**
>
> "yeah, do that, and then file a follow-up issue to benchmark those 2 new models"
> — follow-up to #102, which named `bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B` and
> `convaiinnovations/laya` as the System One candidates.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `bespokelabs/Bespoke-Nimble-9B` is served behind an OpenAI-compatible endpoint the bench can reach, with the serving steps recorded as a `configs/` recipe (high confidence)
- [ ] `convaiinnovations/laya` produces `system1` results through the same OpenAI-compatible transport (a shim/adapter is acceptable); if it cannot be served on this hardware, that outcome and what was checked are recorded instead (high confidence)
- [ ] A `system1` run exists for each served candidate reporting accuracy with a 95 % CI and speed (TTFT / seconds-per-task / tokens-per-second) (high confidence)
- [ ] Candidates are measured under the same suite, samples and settings, and compared against the incumbent baseline in a `bench report` output (medium confidence)
- [ ] Result artifacts are appended under `results/` and public docs/landing-page data reflect the measured numbers (medium confidence)

## Metadata

**Priority:** P2 (medium confidence)
**Effort:** L (medium confidence)
**Suggested model:** GPT-5.6 Sol Extra High · Opus 5 Extra High _(CursorBench 4.0, 2026-09-30 — advisory)_
**Labels:** feature, scope:serving, effort:L (medium confidence)
title: Benchmark Bespoke-Nimble-9B and Laya on the system1 suite
